lines.text: The same little desk. The last line on the clipboard is still waiting to be crossed out.
(again) Somebody meant to come back to it.
The recorder-shaped absence. Four tally marks under the handle. Space for one more.
(again) You remember the shape of it.
The cage is still locked around it. Black bulbs, bright glass. Its wire still ends in open air.
(again) Too carefully held for rubbish. Too dead to be a lamp.
